scope: Behavior, ARIA and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup and client behavior. Its menus are ui-menu's (that record covers them); rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: role=menubar and aria-orientation, menuitem triggers with one roving tab stop, arrows wrapping past disabled menus, Home / End, ArrowDown opening on the first item, ArrowRight in an open menu switching menus (sibling-open), hover switching once a menu is open, Escape, data-orientation and data-has-submenu-open, the vertical bar's keys and side placement, no native form elements
resolveMenubar: 8u composite row, 7u triggers, capped radius, uncapped when vertical
React SSR: the same data-*, roles and tab stop as the web component on the bar and its triggers; arrows, ArrowDown and ArrowRight-in-a-menu in the client with onOpenChange reasons

limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio on :5182 at the theme unit 4.5 and the size ladder 3, 4, 6, B = 0; geometry-check covers u = 2…12 × B = 0, 1, horizontal and vertical): growth (long trigger labels widen their trigger and the bar; a leading slot keeps 6u), RTL (dir=rtl reverses the triggers and the arrows along the bar; the menus open from the trigger's right edge as in ui-menu), focus (the ring is drawn inside the trigger, inset by the thick border width, so it stays within the bar and never changes a trigger's size), floating layer (menus open 1u below their trigger, below unless they do not fit; beside a vertical bar), screenshots of the Menus family checked light and dark with File › Open recent open from the bar.
